description: Extend apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py to include root-level src/sandbox_executor/*.py modules alongside top-level subpackages so root<->subpackage and root<->root import cycles are ratcheted in CI.
goal: Extend apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py so graph discovery treats root-level src/sandbox_executor/*.py modules (excluding __init__.py) as top-level graph nodes alongside subpackages, locking all 6 existing cyclic pairs (entrypoint <-> flow, knowledge <-> ledger, calibration <-> calibration_self_check, entrypoint <-> review_target, flow <-> review_target, and flow <-> flow_guard) at or below their live baseline edge counts while allowing counts to shrink downward.

Add synthetic AST unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py proving that introducing a new root<->subpackage or root<->root import cycle fails the ratchet while shrinking a recorded cycle edge count passes.

Keep apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py strictly within its 350-line budget and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Verify uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass cleanly. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Skipping root-level sandbox_executor/*.py files leaves 4 live bidirectional import cycles unratcheted in CI.
acceptance_criteria: `apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py` includes root-level `src/sandbox_executor/*.py` modules alongside subpackages and locks all 6 existing cyclic pairs at or below their baseline edge counts.
Synthetic AST unit tests verify a newly introduced root<->subpackage or root<->root cycle fails while shrinking a recorded cycle edge count passes.
`uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass with zero docstrings or non-`# why:` comments.
